Madinah is famous for being the city that welcomed Prophet Muhammad, Peace Be Upon Him during the struggles of delivering his message, and it came to be the city where his grave is located. Muslims worldwide visit Madinah to witness Al Masjid Al Nabawy, i.e., Prophet’s Mosque, and see the Prophet’s grave. It’s a peaceful heart-warming city that will leave you overwhelmed with emotions. 2. Can foreigners buy property in Saudi Arabia?

Yes, foreign nationals can buy property in Saudi Arabia, but they must obtain approval from the Ministry of Investment. Typically, expatriates with valid residency (Iqama) are eligible to purchase real estate, especially in designated areas and with proper documentation.
